name: Redis
shortDescription: An in-memory data store used for caching and fast key-value access.
whatItIs: Redis keeps data in memory as keys and structured values, which makes reads and writes fast enough to sit in front of a slower primary store.
howILearned: I worked with Redis as part of a production Node and Express backend during my internship at Aude.ai.
howIUseIt: I use it where a request needs data faster than a round trip to the primary database is worth.
lessonsLearned: A cache is only as useful as its invalidation strategy is clear.

seo.description: How I have worked with Redis in a production Node and Express backend.
